text:
Priya S: Quick note0: we're seeing PM actions slide when ownership isn't explicit. Proposal: 'handoff proof' step before closing an action: owner assigns a named verifier + a one-sentence acceptance criteria.

Luca M: +1. Handoff proof sounds lightweight. Example: `fix-123 10owner:Luca 10verifier:Tanya 10criteria: deploy + smoke test PASS`.

Tanya R: Love that. Also: require a due_date and a 'remediation class' tag (code/process/infra) so we can group later.

Priya S: Agree. Ops asks: can the IC on rotation be responsible for ensuring 'handoff proof' fields are present during the weekly 15m follow-up? Low lift and spreads responsibility.

Luca M: Yes, IC facilitation can be the gate check. IC should also flag items without verifiers as 'needs owner assignment' and add to next sprint if >14d.

Tanya R: Small automation idea: when verifier marks PASS, ops-bot posts a closure line in the original PM thread: `CLOSED: <item> by <owner> verified by <verifier> - <criteria>` so audits are easy.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly "PM followups" Tue 09:15. New tracker columns: verifier, due_date, remediation_class, acceptance_criteria.

Priya S: Concrete actions: 1) Luca -> add acceptance_criteria field + sample values to tracker (due Thu). 2) Tanya -> update IC checklist to include handoff proof check (due Fri). 3) Priya -> ask infra leads about sprint backfilling policy for stale items (>14d) (due Mon).

Luca M: I'll upload sample rows and a tiny script to export counts by remediation_class.

Tanya R: I'll slot the handoff check into the facilitator checklist template.

Priya S: Thanks. If nobody objects I'll push the tracker change and the recurring meeting invite.

Luca M: :+1:

Tanya R: :thumbsup:
